reviews.author: Gachirun Branding Therapy
reviews.text: These days, I went to Euljiro 3-ga, also known as Hipjiro, because I had an appointment with an acquaintance. In a narrow alley that brings back the emotions and memories of going to college, there is a food alley that caters to the tastes of young people. While I was taking pictures in front of a wall with pretty graffiti painted on it, I saw the door that was standing like a drinks vending machine open and people entering the bar, so we spontaneously went in as well. The craft beer was delicious, the atmosphere was nice, and they explained the alcohol content and taste of the beer I ordered, so it was an interesting experience to savor the taste while drinking it.

reviews.author: YJ Oh
reviews.text: The Rench Brewing, which has a brewery in Daejeon, opened and operates a beer pub in Euljiro 3-ga, Seoul. If you are visiting for the first time, you may be hesitant as to where the entrance is, but what is really unique is that the entrance is shaped like a vending machine. The inside feels cramped than expected, the tables are small, and the spacing between tables is narrow. However, all walls inside the store, starting from the entrance, are filled with graffiti, giving it a hip feel, which seems to add to the drinking atmosphere. It is said that the French owner brews his own beer, and you can taste various types of beer including lager, weizen, stout, and newing. The price range is a bit high. They say they are famous for their pizza, and they serve Detroit-style square pizza. You order through a tablet installed at each table. The atmosphere is good, the beer tastes good, and the staff are friendly, so I think it's a good place to drink beer.

reviews.text:
I went to Heijini, a famous hip date restaurant near Euljiro 3-ga Station.
​I ordered Eohyang Eggplant (18,000 won), Classic Cheese Pizza (19,000 won), Genie Highball, and Peach Highball. The combination of the pizza topped with plenty of cheese and the fish-flavored eggplant that was crispy on the outside and moist on the inside was great. I was very satisfied with the meal as it was accompanied by a refreshing highball.
The atmosphere of the store is cozy and hip, making it the perfect place to visit on a date. I recommend it if you are looking for a restaurant in Euljiro with good food and good atmosphere.

reviews.author: Giggle Witch
reviews.text: I've been passing by Eulji a lot, and I finally found out that there's a nice wine bar like this. It was really great. I visited on a weekday evening with my boyfriend and the atmosphere was really nice. The lighting was soft, making conversation easy, and it's a perfect place for a date. I had the Cheese Falls Tomato Pizza and the Fish-Hyang Eggplant and both were very delicious. The pizza was full of cheese and was savory, and the fishy eggplant had an attractive peppery scent on the outside. Maker’s Highball is also very delicious. I recommend it if you’re looking for a nice wine bar near Euljiro 3-ga! ㅠㅠ

reviews.author: Jaehoon Yoon
reviews.text:

The fish seasoning eggplant had a crispy texture and was juicy, so it was really delicious.

I made a reservation for 6:30 PM on Saturday. I don't think reservations are required during this time. There were some seats left. However, it seemed like a reservation was required to sit at the window.

I chose it because it had a nice atmosphere.

Overall, the quality was not bad for the price, but I felt that the taste was lacking by 2%.

The bread before the meal was moderately salty and the butter was delicious, but the bread felt a bit dry.

The onion soup was so tasty that it could be considered a dish in itself rather than just whetting the appetite. Rather than feeling bad about myself, I thought it would have been better if I had controlled the order in which I ate.

The lasagna was unique in that it was cooked to a crispy texture, but it felt like there wasn't enough sauce overall, which was disappointing.

Geumtae risotto was really good to eat with lemon. However, if you don't sprinkle lemon, it will feel like you are eating home-cooked food in the country, so be sure to sprinkle lemon on it.

reviews.text:
A premium pasta and pizza restaurant that has been consistently loved in Jonggak for 12 years!
They say they make all the sauces in-house to create a deep flavor.

The spicy stir-fried pasta is 15,900 won, and the Le Bois Pane is 17,600 won. The addictive fire flavor and cream were really delicious!
The cream sauce dipped in garlic bread was especially kicky.
Vongole 19,800 won was full of fresh clams, and the subtle scent of white wine rose up, making the cool taste spread throughout my mouth.

During weekday lunchtime, if you order only one menu item per person, you can even get a free pizza!
Be sure to grab the free Naver Place coupon too.
The lighting is soft and the tables are spaced well apart, so it's a great place for a date or with friends to create a great atmosphere and take pictures. It's a comfortable space even if you come alone and with a group!

reviews.author: Cheese Cheddar
reviews.text:
I wasn't expecting it, but it was delicious.
The two of us washed 3 dishes haha;;

The price is reasonable these days considering the cost of living and space.
These days, if you want to eat paneer, pasta, or pizza at a Western-style restaurant with a good atmosphere for a date, you should expect 20,000 won per menu as standard, but most of them are in the 17,000 won range, so I don't think it's bad.

If you order one menu per person or get a coupon from Naver, you can eat pizza for free.
Thin Dough Pizza is crispy and delicious.
I especially recommend the garlic pizza.

Levwa Pane is a basic cream pane, but it is slightly spicy, so it has a greasy taste.
It was a thick creamy pasta.
The bread was spread with butter so it was soft and melted!

I had the risotto ragu and it was spicy, but it was soft because it had potatoes as a topping.

Overall, I recommend this place when looking for a cost-effective pasta restaurant in Jongno.
The owner is also very kind.
(I visited on a weekday evening.)

If you make a reservation, you will be guided to a window seat, so the view is also good haha.

• Green tea flavor: A must-try if you’re a matcha fan! The rich tea aroma is slightly sweetened, and the filling has a more chewy texture, leaving a subtle tea aroma in your mouth.

• Milk taste: The pure milk flavor, reminiscent of hardened Hokkaido milk pudding, is subtle and satisfying.

• Popular peanut butter flavor: The salty and sweet peanut butter taste is strong and the soft texture is attractive.

reviews.text: A dessert shaved ice and waffle house reminiscent of the old Seesaw and Can More days. The interior also feels like that time. The price was a little expensive (26,000 won for two people), but it was a treat for both the eyes and the mouth. Come to think of it, considering the price in Myeong-dong, where street vendors sell bungeoppang for 5,000 won per four pieces, it doesn't seem like a bad price. The composition is good, the ingredients are good, and the taste is definitely good. Waffles are made by baking the dough directly rather than freezing it. It's not in the picture, but I added Americano to make a sweet and bitter combination, and it went on endlessly. However, the whipped cream was a bit greasy so I couldn't eat it all. Even though I knew it was a very fat-gaining combination, I couldn’t stop. The owner and staff are all very friendly. It would be nice if a lot of foreign tourists came. I ate well.
